newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.

LIVE CATTLE - steady to 0.10 cent lower. Cash cattle trade likely to be slow with bids around $61 to $62 per cwt and offers in the $64 to $65 range. Some strength may be derived from firming beef values but there is sentiment that the run-up in futures late last week may have been overdone.
FEEDER CATTLE - off 0.10 to 0.25 cent. Stronger overnight CBOT corn prices could spark some early selling although CME feeder cattle index continues to rise.
LEAN HOGS - up 0.15 to 0.20 cent. Cash hogs seen fully $0.50 higher Monday as hot, humid weather in the U.S. Midwest slows movement. Product prices also strengthening.
PORK BELLIES - up 0.20 to 0.30 cent. Firmness in the cash fresh belly market amid a continued light slaughter should spark a modest early advance.
